nodes.description: Private uint256 _totalShares tracking the sum of all payee shares.
Private uint256 _totalReleased tracking total Ether already released.
Private mapping(address => uint256) _shares of payee to assigned shares.
Private mapping(address => uint256) _released of payee to Ether already paid out.
Private address[] _payees list of all payee addresses.
Private mapping(IERC20 => uint256) _erc20TotalReleased of token totals released.
Private mapping(IERC20 => mapping(address => uint256)) _erc20Released per token and payee.
receive() external payable virtual; emits PaymentReceived(_msgSender(), msg.value).
release(address payable account) public virtual; computes pending Ether payment, updates _released and _totalReleased then transfers via Address.sendValue.
release(IERC20 token, address account) public virtual; computes pending token payment, updates _erc20Released and _erc20TotalReleased then transfers via SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
_pendingPayment(address,uint256,uint256) private view; returns (totalReceived * _shares[account]) / _totalShares - alreadyReleased.
_addPayee(address,uint256) private; pushes payee, records shares and increases _totalShares.
PaymentSplitter constructor validating array lengths and invoking _addPayee in a loop.
MetaDogePayments constructor forwarding payees and shares to PaymentSplitter, payable.
totalShares() public view returns _totalShares.
totalReleased() public view returns _totalReleased.
totalReleased(IERC20 token) public view returns _erc20TotalReleased[token].
shares(address account) public view returns _shares[account].
released(address account) public view returns _released[account].
released(IERC20 token, address account) public view returns _erc20Released[token][account].
payee(uint256 index) public view returns _payees[index].
msg.sender as returned by Context._msgSender().
Address.sendValue low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwarding all gas to an arbitrary payee, enabling reentrant callbacks.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer performing an external token call on an attacker-controlled ERC20 address.
Address.functionCallWithValue target.call{value: value}(data) low-level external call used by SafeERC20.
Context._msgSender() internal view virtual returning msg.sender.
Address.sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) library helper that performs the raw value call.
account: payee address argument of release(address payable).
token: IERC20 argument of release(IERC20,address).
account: payee address argument of release(IERC20,address).
account: payee address argument of _pendingPayment.
totalReceived: cumulative asset amount argument of _pendingPayment.
alreadyReleased: amount previously withdrawn argument of _pendingPayment.
account: payee address argument of _addPayee.
shares_: share amount argument of _addPayee.
payees: array of payee addresses in the PaymentSplitter constructor.
shares_: array of share amounts in the PaymentSplitter constructor.
_payees: payee array forwarded by the MetaDogePayments constructor.
_shares: share array forwarded by the MetaDogePayments constructor.
index: array position argument of payee(uint256).
account: address argument of the shares(address) getter.
account: address argument of the released(address) getter.
token: IERC20 argument of the totalReleased(IERC20) getter.
token: IERC20 argument of the released(IERC20,address) getter.
account: address argument of the released(IERC20,address) getter.
payment: computed Ether amount local to release(address payable).
totalReceived: address(this).balance + totalReleased() local to release(address payable).
payment: computed token amount local to release(IERC20,address).
totalReceived: token.balanceOf(this) + totalReleased(token) local to release(IERC20,address).
i: loop counter in the PaymentSplitter constructor payee registration loop.

account indexes _shares inside _pendingPayment.
totalReceived is multiplied by the payee share in _pendingPayment.
alreadyReleased is subtracted from the computed payout in _pendingPayment, risking underflow.
account is recorded as a new payee by _addPayee.
shares_ is written into _shares and added to _totalShares by _addPayee.

shares_ array is length-checked and iterated by the PaymentSplitter constructor.

totalReceived is derived from balance plus totalReleased inside release(address payable).
payment is computed and later transferred inside release(IERC20,address).

release(address payable) reads _shares[account] in its require check.
release(address payable) reads and then increments _totalReleased.
release(address payable) increments _released[account] before transferring.
release(address payable) calls _pendingPayment to compute the payout.
release(address payable) hands control to Address.sendValue, which performs the raw value transfer.
The low-level call{value:} inside sendValue can re-enter release(address payable) after state update.
Address.sendValue executes the unsafe recipient.call{value: amount}("") operation.

release(IERC20,address) reads and increments _erc20TotalReleased[token].
release(IERC20,address) increments the _erc20Released[token][account] balance.
release(IERC20,address) calls _pendingPayment to compute the payout.
release(IERC20,address) delegates the transfer to SafeERC20.safeTransfer on an arbitrary token.
The external token transfer can re-enter release(IERC20,address) if the token is malicious.
SafeERC20 performs the token call through Address.functionCallWithValue.
The low-level target.call{value: value}(data) can re-enter the SafeERC20 caller path.
_pendingPayment multiplies totalReceived by _shares[account], a value-dependent arithmetic operation.
_pendingPayment divides by _totalShares without a zero check, a division-by-zero arithmetic risk.
_addPayee increases _totalShares by the new payee shares.
_addPayee writes the new payee share into _shares.
_addPayee pushes the account onto the _payees array.
The PaymentSplitter constructor invokes _addPayee for each payee in the loop.
MetaDogePayments constructor calls the PaymentSplitter constructor.
